name: Milgrey Finance & Investments Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1983, Milgrey Finance and Investments Ltd is in the business of finance and investment
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company does finance and investment and used to finance film producers. Company currently deals in investment into shares and securities on short term and long term basis

cons: Stock is trading at 4.86 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.62% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 82.0% of their holding.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.62 Cr.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -33.4%
